title: Another vivo V80 is coming, certification reveals
description: A few days ago, vivo launched the V80, which follows in the footsteps of the V80 Lite that got official last month. But the V80 series isn't done yet - there's (at least) another member of the family on the way. Indonesia's SDPPI has certified a vivo phone with the model number V2624 under the name vivo V80 FE. Unfortunately, the certification doesn't reveal any specs or any details about the phone whatsoever, aside from its name and model number. But this does mean that the V80 FE is on the way and coming soon. It will of course act as the successor to the V70 FE, which came out in...

title: Xiaomi's HyperOS 4 supports photos, messages, and files sync with iPhone
description: Xiaomi's HyperOS 4 will have a deeper integration with Apple's iOS and the iPhone. The latest additions are pretty impressive. Xiaomi smartphone owners will be able to share photos, files, contacts, and web pages with an iPhone. Even better, HyperOS 4 will let users view cloud photo albums on either smartphone. There are also real-time notifications and instant message replies across the two ecosystems thanks to two-way sync. title: Amazon Kids Tablets are now official in two sizes
description: Today Amazon has unveiled two tablets aimed at kids, and they're unsurprisingly called the Amazon Kids Tablets. They are available in 8.7" and 11" sizes, with two distinct models, one made for ages 3+, the other for ages 6+. The 8.7-inch tablet has 64GB of storage and its battery lasts for up to 14 hours of video playback, while the 11" model has "a beautiful 2.5K display" and 8GB of RAM. Every version runs Android and ships with a kid-proof case and a year of the Kids+ subscription, which features curated content from Disney, Nickelodeon, Lego, and Sesame Street, plus "parent-managed...

title: The OLED MacBook Pro may not be much thinner than the current model
description: Apple's long-rumored OLED MacBook Pro, which will be its first laptop with a touchscreen, may not end up being much thinner than the current model, according to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman. He has thus contradicted his own previous predictions, now saying that he doesn't think "it'll be significantly thinner in the end". For reference, the current MacBook Pro 14" is 15.5mm thick and weighs between 1.55kg and 1.62kg, while the 16-inch model is 16.8mm thick and weighs between 2.14kg and 2.15kg. So there's definitely a lot of room to make the new ones lighter, and perhaps slightly thinner...

title: Amazon's new Alexa Tablets use the Google Play Store and are more capable than Fire tablets
description: Amazon first got into the tablet game with the Kindle Fire. It later dropped the “Kindle” branding to emphasize that its tablets do more than its e-readers. And now the company is changing tack again with the introduction of the Amazon Alexa tablets. As you can tell from the name, AI is a big part of this. However, the change in naming also emphasizes that these are fully-featured Android tablets – Fire tablets were known for being cheap but good enough (and did we mention cheap?). title: Here's how thin the iPhone Air 2 will be despite having better battery life than its predecessor
description: According to a new rumor, the iPhone Air 2, expected to launch next spring alongside the iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e, will be even thinner than its predecessor. How thin? 5.2mm. That's 0.4mm less than the original iPhone Air from 2025. Obviously it's a tiny difference, but you can't really expect much since the iPhone Air was already very thin. title: Oppo Find X10 and Pro Max unboxing and hands-on
description: This is your first look at the Oppo Find X10 series, which will go global on October 21. The Oppo Find X10 Pro Max and Find X10 launched in China in late September, so we know the specs. The Oppo Find X10 Pro Max is the larger of the two, owing to its larger display. It's not a huge gap, however - the Find X10 isn't a tiny compact phone. title: WhatsApp is creating a new Contacts tab in its app
description: WhatsApp is now testing a dedicated Contacts tab in its Android app. It shows up in the latest beta version which is available through the Google Play Store for those who are enrolled in the beta program. Thus, it's still a work in progress and not available to everyone yet. As you can see in the screenshot below, Contacts is now a new tab in the Android app's navigation bar. It shows your contacts, unsurprisingly, and shows you which of them are currently online with a green dot. title: Report: Samsung is cutting up to 30% of its smartphone production in Q4
description: The ongoing memory chip crisis has been plaguing tech companies for months and a new report from Korea’s Money Today suggests that Samsung is ready to significantly cut its smartphone production as a result. According to the report, Samsung Mobile Experience (MX) has already reached out to suppliers to reduce their production volumes by 20-30%. This is specifically for the Q4 months (i.e October-December) and according to estimates, Samsung is now expected to cap off the year with around 200 million smartphone shipments instead of the previously estimated 270 million figure. title: Oppo Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max to launch globally on October 21
description: After unveiling the Find X10 series in China last month, Oppo has now confirmed when the phones will launch in global markets. However, it appears that only the Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max will be making their way to international markets. The Oppo Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max will launch globally on October 21 at an event taking place in Mallorca, Spain. Notably, Oppo’s official UK online store began accepting pre-orders for the phones in September. The company will reveal global pricing and availability at the upcoming event in Spain. title: Samsung Electronics announces its earnings guidance for Q3 2026
description: Samsung Electronics has announced its earnings guidance for the third quarter of 2026, covering July to September. Samsung said its consolidated sales for the period were approximately KRW 195 trillion ($145.33 billion), while consolidated operating profit was approximately KRW 107.40 trillion ($80 billion). In comparison, Samsung's consolidated sales for the second quarter of 2026 (April to June) were worth KRW 171.5 trillion ($127.78 billion), while the operating profit was KRW 89.49 trillion ($66.68 billion). title: Microsoft reveals Surface Laptop Ultra price and availability
description: Announced at Computex earlier this year, the Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra is finally available for pre-order. The flagship laptop is powered by Nvidia’s RTX Spark SoC and is set to compete with Apple’s rumored MacBook Ultra. The Surface Laptop Ultra is currently available to pre-order through Microsoft’s official online store and select retailers worldwide. It starts at $2,599, with open sales beginning October 16. title: RedMagic 12 Pro+ design and color options revealed ahead of launch
description: The RedMagic 12 Pro+ is set to launch in China on October 15. Ahead of the launch, the company has revealed the phone’s full design and color options, with pre-orders now live. In a post on Weibo, RedMagic confirmed that the 12 Pro+ will feature the company’s signature transparent design, a flat rear panel, and RGB liquid cooling. The phone will be available in Transparent Dark Night, Transparent Ice Blue, and Transparent Silver Wing colorways. title: Everyone can now check if an image, video, or audio file was made with AI
description: Starting today, Google is making its SynthID Detector tool available to everyone across the globe in English. This tool can be used to find out if an image, video, or audio file was made with AI from Google, OpenAI, Nvidia, or Kakao. Soon, the SynthID Detector will also detect media that was created with Apple's AI tools. For its part, Google says it's watermarked over 180 billion images and videos and "240,000 years of audio content" with SynthID since it was launched in 2023. title: You can now pre-order Xreal’s Aura Android XR glasses, here's how much they cost
description: Xreal announced its Aura Android XR glasses back in June, when it started taking reservations for them. Today, those who hold a reservation can move to the next step and place a pre-order for a pair, starting with the US, Canada, Japan, and South Korea. More regions will get this option soon. title: Samsung Galaxy F70 is on its way and could be a rebrand job
description: After launching the Galaxy F70e in February and the Galaxy F70 Pro in August, Samsung is now working on a third member of this family, namely the 'vanilla' Galaxy F70. description: Today Samsung has announced that it's partnered up with former French football star Thierry Henry to promote the Galaxy Z Fold8, Fold8 Ultra, and Flip8.
